hypotheses.title: Country Challenge Leaderboard Breakout: 4 Radical Alphas Targeting EXCELLENT and SPECTACULAR Status
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Engineered specifically to maximize all three country-level leaderboard dimensions (IS Score, Uniqueness, Days of Submission) to qualify for the WorldQuant BRAIN Research Consultant programme ($8,000+/quarter stipends): (1) 3-Year LEAP Call Term Premium + VWAP Dislocation in Sector Neutralization: Couples long-dated institutional options flow with intraday execution discounts. (2) Idiosyncratic Risk Reversal + Audited Annual FX Super Alpha: Fuses model51 unsystematic variance exhaustion with 10-K balance sheet translation adjustments (maximizing the Uniqueness dimension). (3) Consensus Forward Cash Flow Per Share Yield + VWAP Reversion: Deploys accrual-free cashflow yields with liquidity mean-reversion. (4) 1-Year Call Volatility + Audited Annual FX in Sector Neutralization: Upgrades Alpha 17 to Sector scope, aiming for Sharpe >= 2.10 and Fitness >= 1.80.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if multi-asset signals share latent factor exposures during market stress.
